slides.title: Work with agents in native chat
slides.description: Use Codex and Claude Code inside Grove, with approvals, structured questions, attachments, clear tool activity, and conversation navigation. Read Mermaid diagrams and interact with inline HTML previews.

slides.title: Refine and redirect your work
slides.description: Queue and edit upcoming messages, steer active turns, or edit sent messages inline with checkpoint-backed workspace recovery. Your unrelated composer drafts stay intact.

slides.title: Follow tasks across turns
slides.description: Track native agent checklists above the composer and see progress in the sidebar and grid. Expand the task list or jump to where a task started, with checklist state preserved across turns.

slides.title: Keep checkout actions close
slides.description: Use the checkout card at the upper right on wide layouts or its header disclosure on narrow layouts. Inspect changes, see outgoing commit status, open Finder, add or run project scripts, and commit, push, or publish with clear progress.

slides.title: Keep agent conversations in Grove
slides.description: Work with Codex and Claude Code in native chat. Follow tool activity, handle approvals, and answer structured questions without losing your message draft.

slides.title: Refine your next message
slides.description: Queue messages while your agent works, then edit or remove them in the pending message tray before they are sent.

slides.title: Stay in control of the conversation
slides.description: Keep your place while replies stream, select transcript text, and open Markdown artifact links. Refined chat bubbles and composer behavior make longer conversations easier to follow.

slides.title: See which sessions need you
slides.description: Clearer native agent activity and question states help you find the next session to visit. Compact sidebar icons keep the agent centered with its working indicator in the lower-right corner.

slides.title: Find your next session
slides.description: Browse sessions in the compact sidebar or its project popup. Clearer titles, activity icons, Git changes, and cmd+b / ctrl+b keep navigation simple.

slides.title: Work across projects
slides.description: Choose worktrees from different projects in one launcher, then start your agent with their shared context. Launch directly from worktree rows and compact project popups, too.

slides.title: Keep Grove up to date
slides.description: Updates check the latest release again before installing. Restart when you are ready. Downloads and installers are smaller, too.

slides.title: More room for your work
slides.description: Collapse the sidebar into a compact rail. Your projects, sessions, and workspace controls stay within reach.

media.alt: Grove expands its sidebar to show project names, then collapses it into a compact rail. The sidebar toggle is outlined in each state.

slides.title: Move projects between workspaces
slides.description: Move a project to another workspace without rebuilding its setup. Keep its worktrees and sessions together.

media.alt: Move to workspace dialog showing Experiments selected for Cedar.

slides.title: Close sessions with confidence
slides.description: Closing a running session asks for confirmation, even from the compact sidebar or keyboard shortcut. Its worktree stays on disk.

media.alt: Grove asks for confirmation before closing a running terminal session.
